text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r e-d-i-t-e-d t-h-e l-a-b r-e-p-o-r-t-s t-o h-i-d-e d-e-f-e-c-t-s, l-e-f-t s-h-r-o-d-i-n-g c-o-p-i-e-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e o-r-i-g-i-n-a-l d-a-t-a v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-d-d-e-d f-a-k-e c-e-r-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n m-a-r-k-s t-o p-a-c-k-a-g-i-n-g, l-e-f-t p-r-i-n-t t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e l-i-c-e-n-s-e d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-h-a-n-g-e-d a-g-e w-a-r-n-i-n-g l-a-b-e-l-s t-o i-n-d-i-c-a-t-e s-a-f-e-t-y, l-e-f-t o-l-d l-a-b-e-l s-t-o-c-k, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r-y c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e c-h-e-c-k.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-h-i-p-p-e-d i-n-v-e-n-t-o-r-y b-e-f-o-r-e a-u-d-i-t-s, l-e-f-t l-o-g-i-s-t-i-c-s m-a-n-i-f-e-s-t-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e q-u-a-l-i-t-y g-u-a-r-a-n-t-e-e r-e-v-i-e-w.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r i-n-f-o-r-m-e-d s-a-l-e-s t-e-a-m-s t-o m-o-v-e s-t-o-c-k q-u-i-c-k-l-y, l-e-f-t e-m-a-i-l t-h-r-e-a-d-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e l-e-g-a-l r-e-v-i-e-w f-o-r c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e.
